findings.reason: The approved density case allows ν_k to have a Lebesgue density with S positive through t, but the Statement additionally requires S continuous. Drop that extra condition and prove S(u−)=S(u) Lebesgue-a.e.: their difference is P(T=u), and the total event-time law has at most countably many atoms, which ν_k assigns zero mass. Then dΛ_k=(f_k/S)du a.e. and the stated integral formula follows. This is a same-item repair; no new prerequisite is needed.
